changes: Captured scans now save on this device as you work, including original pages, page order and completed files waiting to be sent.
Recover unfinished scans after reopening Teluva in the same account and space. Failed uploads keep the recovery copy; download a backup or explicitly discard it when ready.
The scanner shows saving and storage-error status, supports retry when device storage is unavailable, and lets a recovered batch continue from uploaded photos.
